config.label: A control-plane API access token
config.description: A control-plane API access token. One of this, the OAuth client pair, or the OAuth JWT file is needed for the tailnet tools; without any of them only the local tools are offered.

config.label: An OAuth client id, used with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET when there is no API access token
config.description: An OAuth client id, used with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET when there is no API access token.

config.label: The OAuth client secret that goes with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
config.description: The OAuth client secret that goes with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

config.label: The tailnet the control-plane tools act on
config.description: The tailnet the control-plane tools act on. Without it they act on the one the credential belongs to.

config.label: Which tools are offered: minimal, core or full
config.description: Which tools are offered: minimal, core or full.

config.label: Offer the tools that change something
config.description: Offer the tools that change something. Read-only without it.

config.label: Offer the tools that remove or sever something
config.description: Offer the tools that remove or sever something. Implies the write tier.
